name: opencode-commandcode
install: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.bun/bin:$HOME/.opencode/bin:$PATH" && (command -v bun >/dev/null || curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash) && (command -v opencode >/dev/null || curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash) && npm config set prefix "$HOME/.local" && npm i -g command-code@latest && bun install && bun run build
